RE/MAX BonBini Curacao Homes for sale Cas Grandi – Spacious fixer-upper with apartment in a quiet location

Cas Grandi – Spacious fixer-upper with apartment in a quiet location

Cas Grandi Curacao

€ 480.232

Under contract

Property details

Price: € 480.232
Bedrooms: 6
Bathrooms: 3
Available: Immediately
Lot size: 448 sq ft
Pets allowed: Yes
Pool: Yes
Sea view: Yes

Looking for a spacious villa with plenty of potential? The property has already been fully stripped and offers endless possibilities to finish it entirely to your own taste. The home is situated on a large plot in a quiet neighborhood.

On the ground floor of the property, there is a spacious apartment featuring two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a large living room with kitchen. Additionally, there is a utility/laundry room and a spacious garage with room for two cars. This area also offers the potential to create an additional apartment if desired.

Via the staircase in the hallway, you reach the upper floor of the property. Here, you’ll find a large open space that can be customized entirely to your needs—whether as a spacious living room, kitchen, porch, or additional bedrooms. This floor already includes four bedrooms. The master bedroom features a large en-suite bathroom, while the other bedrooms share a guest bathroom.

Through a door at the rear of the property, you access the pool area. This includes a large swimming pool, a pool bar, and sanitary facilities.

All in all, this property offers plenty of possibilities and potential. Please note: no rights can be derived from impressions. To get a complete understanding of the property and its possibilities, we recommend scheduling a viewing.


Cas Grandi Curacao

Cas Grandi Curacao (“large house”) is situated on the South East side of Curacao, known as “Banda Ariba”.
The neighbourhood Cas Grandi is situated just 15 minutes from downtown Willemstad and approx. 30 minutes by car from Hato airport. It is easy accessible by car and the closest beach can be reached in 10 minutes.

Cas Grandi is situated on a hill next to Spanish Water Lagoon. Therefore many homes have a beautiful view of the famous Tafelberg. The elevated lots also enjoy a nice cool breeze.
